title: Audit event payload (W6)
description: The agreement between a live observation and its second scoring from the recording, computed by rules.inter_observer_agreement against the calibration thresholds. Shares and flags only: neither observer's scores enter the event log. agreed false refers the first observer back to W5 (referred_to_calibration), which lapses their calibration until their next passed one.

observation.description: Id of the observation event audited

observer.description: The first observer, whose scoring is audited

signoff_id.description: The second observer's scoring sign-off the result was computed from
